title: Fantastic work
text: Vanessa is an excellent professional. It made me feel very calm and time flew by. I was very relaxed and she took care to explain the details of the process to me.
author: Destination300269

title: Highly recommended!
text: This massage was performed in a very expert way.  It was a massage plus where various skills were used.  It was a very nice experience!  Roberto and his wife are also very nice people.  Highly recommended!
author: Danielle1981D

title: They left us looking like new to spend the weekend in Granada.
text: A very satisfying experience. We would definitely return again, we were given the appointment a few hours earlier and it has been the most relaxing massage I have ever done in my life.
author: rociodelmarg622

title: Excellent
text: We chose the one hour massage and could not leave more delighted, Excellent professionals, We would repeat without hesitation.
author: 631ashp

title: Great Experience!
text: Wow the massage was great.  My massage therapist went well over the time and really worked on me.  I feel so relaxed and loose after.  I would highly recommend them!
author: Kenneth_G

title: I left there like new
text: A massage at MasVital is really worth it. Rosa Maria worked miracles with me and I came out of there like new. Highly, highly recommended!
author: carmenmO1247JM

title: Wonderful massage and lovely people
text: It was amazing! The lady was so skilled, she sorted out all my knots and it felt wonderful. She was also very friendly. Definitely recommend, much better massage than at the Hammams.
author: R1239FGstephaniep

title: One of the best massages of my life
text: I've been to the center for massages several times and I never leave disappointed. This time it was Rosa that left me feeling like new. A relaxing massage and at the same time wonderful decontractor. I highly recommend it.
author: Mari Carmen L

title: Extraordinary
text: The very good and very relaxing massage which is what I was looking for. The masseuse, Sofia, extraordinary, combining different techniques
author: Miguel G

title: A great massage.
text: Very good experience, great professionals. No doubt to repeat again. Thank you for everything MASVITAL.
author: Consuelo S
